items.title: 🧬 8/31 馮玉蓮博士專題講座：Beyond the Wet Lab — How AI is Radically Accelerating Translational Science
items.kind: 需報名（唯一需要行動的信；日期還早，但報名要現在做）
items.detail:
這是今天唯一需要你動作的信，來自成大前瞻醫療器材科技中心（MDIC）。主題是 AI 如何把「濕實驗室（Wet Lab）」的資料處理與模型預測接到臨床應用，也就是轉譯科學（translational science）的加速。講者馮玉蓮博士（Yiu-Lian Fong, PhD, MBA）資歷很強：現任新加坡分子診斷公司 MiRXES 的資深科學顧問兼資深企業策略顧問、DxRxPM Biotech Consulting 創辦人，更關鍵的是她曾任嬌生（J&J）旗下 Janssen 的全球臨床生物標記與診斷策略主管（Global Head of Clinical Biomarker & Diagnostic Strategy）——這是「產業界真的在做決策的人」，不是純學術演講。

對化工背景的你，價值在兩層：第一層是內容，生物標記（biomarker）篩選、製程與資料建模、模型預測取代部分實驗設計，這條線跟化工的程序模擬、DOE（實驗設計）、資料驅動最佳化是同一套方法論，只是換到生醫題材；第二層是人脈與視野，一位從大藥廠全球職位走到新創顧問的講者，Q&A 是問「產業界怎麼看 AI 導入的實際瓶頸」的好機會。

時間地點：2026/8/31（一）10:00–11:20，成大生醫卓群大樓 4 樓交誼廳（4F, 2nd Building of Medical School）。主辦：前瞻醫療器材科技中心，電話 06-2757575 分機 31211。報名連結在信件正文（Google 表單）。信中另附講座海報 PDF「2608馮玉蓮博士講座海報.pdf」。

今天要做的事只有一件：把報名填掉，然後用下方按鈕把 8/31 推進 Notion。開學前一週的行程很容易被排擠掉，先卡位。

items.en: Strait of Hormuz Traffic Stays Minimal as the World Burns Through Its Oil Stockpiles
items.zh: 荷姆茲海峽船運量仍低迷，全球正在燒庫存石油
items.summary: The International Energy Agency warned that global oil stockpiles are being drawn down at a rapid clip because traffic through the Strait of Hormuz remains minuscule, despite President Donald Trump's insistence that the strait is open. Roughly a fifth of the world's seaborne oil normally passes through the waterway, so even a partial shutdown forces refiners to lean on reserves. Analysts say the buffer that has kept prices from spiking is finite, and that the market is now trading the question of how many weeks of cover remain rather than the headline risk of closure itself.

items.en: Two ADNOC Vessels Attacked While Transiting the Strait of Hormuz
items.zh: 阿布達比國家石油公司兩艘船在荷姆茲海峽遭攻擊，無人傷亡
items.summary: The Abu Dhabi National Oil Company said two of its vessels were attacked on Thursday evening while transiting the Strait of Hormuz, though no injuries were reported. The incident is the clearest sign yet that the waterway is not functionally open regardless of official statements, and it directly undercuts the argument that shipping can normalise while the conflict continues. Insurers had already repriced war-risk premiums for the Gulf; a confirmed strike on a state-owned Emirati operator raises the prospect that even non-belligerent flags are no longer treated as safe passage.

items.en: Catastrophic Flooding in Indiana as a 1-in-1,000-Year Rainfall Hits the Midwest
items.zh: 印第安納州千年一遇暴雨釀災，中西部再迎新一波洪水威脅
items.summary: Relentless storms have unleashed catastrophic flooding across Indiana, where parts of the state were hit with rainfall totals classified as a 1-in-1,000-year event. Forecasters warned that another round of dangerous flooding was moving from Iowa and northern Illinois toward the already battered Ohio Valley. Emergency managers described water rescues in communities where drainage systems were overwhelmed within hours. The event adds to a run of extreme-rainfall disasters in the US interior and renews questions about whether flood infrastructure designed to historical rainfall statistics is still fit for purpose.

items.en: White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt to Step Down at the End of August
items.zh: 白宮發言人李威特將於八月底離任，期中選舉前三個月大改組
items.summary: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt announced she will leave her role at the end of August, a major shake-up of the administration's communications operation less than three months before the midterm elections. The timing is unusual: press shops normally freeze personnel changes heading into a campaign, so the departure invites speculation about internal friction over messaging on the Iran conflict and the economy. No successor was named. Whoever takes over inherits a briefing room that has been dominated by war coverage and oil-price politics for most of the summer.

items.en: Trump Insists the US Controls Hormuz; Iran Says It Could 'Prolong' the War
items.zh: 川普堅稱美國控制荷姆茲，伊朗稱有能力「拉長」戰事
items.summary: President Trump repeated that the United States controls the Strait of Hormuz and that shipping is free to move, while Iranian officials countered that they retain the ability to prolong the conflict with the US indefinitely. The two statements describe incompatible realities, and shipping data has so far tracked the Iranian version more closely than the American one. The rhetorical standoff matters for markets because it removes any near-term diplomatic offramp: Tehran has tied talks to compensation demands, and Washington has ruled that out.

items.en: Anthropic Says It Will Embed Invisible Watermarks in Claude-Generated Text
items.zh: Anthropic 宣布將在 Claude 產生的文字中嵌入隱形浮水印
items.summary: Anthropic announced it will embed invisible watermarks into text generated by Claude, making machine-written output detectable without changing how it reads. Text watermarking is technically harder than image watermarking because there is far less redundancy to hide a signal in, and paraphrasing can strip it. The move lands as schools and publishers push for provenance tooling, and it puts competitive pressure on rivals who have so far shipped detection promises rather than shipped detection. For students, the practical implication is that 'undetectable' AI text is becoming a shorter-lived assumption.

items.en: OpenAI Ships a Cyber-Defense Model Behind a Review Gate After It Found Two Chrome Zero-Days
items.zh: OpenAI 推出審核制資安防禦模型，GPT-5.6-Cyber 已找出兩個 Chrome 零日漏洞
items.summary: OpenAI released a cyber-defense-specific model under a review-based access system rather than open availability, after its GPT-5.6-Cyber system reportedly discovered two Chrome zero-day vulnerabilities. The gated release is the interesting part: it concedes that a model good enough to find real exploits is also good enough to write them, so distribution becomes the safety control rather than refusal training. Expect the same pattern in biology and chemistry tooling, where capability and misuse potential are similarly entangled and vetting the user is easier than neutering the model.

items.en: Gemini Passes One Billion Users as Google Reshuffles DeepMind's Command Structure
items.zh: Gemini 用戶破 10 億，Google 同步改組 DeepMind 指揮體系
items.summary: Google said Gemini has reached one billion users, a scale milestone that reflects distribution through Search, Android and Workspace as much as standalone demand. At the same time Google reshuffled DeepMind's leadership structure, tightening the reporting lines between research and product. Taken together the two items describe a company converting a research lab into an operating division. The commentary around 12–13 August framed this as the week the AI race visibly shifted from a contest of raw capability to a contest over governance, capital and distribution.

items.en: Rays Complete Only the Second 9-0 West Coast Road Trip in MLB History
items.zh: 光芒隊完成美職史上第二次西岸客場 9 戰全勝，8-4 收下運動家
items.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays beat the Athletics 8-4 on Thursday to finish a nine-game West Coast road trip without a loss, only the second perfect 9-0 West Coast swing in Major League Baseball history. Long West Coast trips are traditionally where East Coast clubs bleed games to travel and time-zone fatigue, which is what makes the sweep notable rather than merely good. The run reshapes the American League playoff picture with roughly six weeks of the regular season remaining.

items.en: Leagues Cup League Phase Wraps Up on 13 August
items.zh: 2026 美洲聯賽盃小組賽階段 8/13 收官，晉級名單出爐
items.summary: The 2026 Leagues Cup league phase concluded on 13 August with the final round of group-stage fixtures across the MLS and Liga MX competition. The revamped format seeds clubs from both leagues into a single table before knockout rounds, so the closing matchday decided several qualification places simultaneously rather than in isolated groups. Attention now turns to the knockout draw, where the tournament's continental berths are on the line.

items.en: Praggnanandhaa Loses at the Sinquefield Cup; India Pull Out of ASEAN Cup for Brazil Friendly
items.zh: 印度棋王普拉格南達辛克菲爾德盃落敗；印度退出東協盃改打巴西友誼賽
items.summary: Indian grandmaster R. Praggnanandhaa lost his round at the Sinquefield Cup, part of the 2026 Grand Chess Tour, while in football the All India Football Federation withdrew from the ASEAN Cup in order to prioritise a friendly against Brazil. The chess result matters for tour standings, where the Sinquefield Cup traditionally carries the heaviest weighting of the season. The football decision is more contested domestically, trading a competitive continental tournament for a single high-profile fixture.

items.en: School Mental Health Publishes New Research on Suicide Prevention in K-12 Schools
items.zh: 《School Mental Health》期刊發表 K-12 校園自殺防治新研究
items.summary: The journal School Mental Health published original research in August 2026 on suicide prevention programmes in K-12 schools, adding to an evidence base that has grown quickly but unevenly. The recurring finding across this literature is that universal screening only helps when it is paired with a referral pathway that actually has capacity; without it, screening identifies need that the system cannot absorb. The paper is relevant to anyone designing campus wellbeing programmes rather than only to clinicians.

items.en: Frontiers Editorial Reviews the Long-Term Educational Fallout of the Pandemic
items.zh: Frontiers 期刊社論回顧疫情對教育場域心理健康的長期衝擊
items.summary: An editorial published on 10 August 2026 in Frontiers in Education reviewed the long-term impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic on mental health and wellbeing in educational settings, focusing on underlying mechanisms and intervention strategies. The authors argue that the measurable damage was less about the virus than about the sustained loss of routine, peer contact and predictable assessment. Six years on, the cohorts who were in secondary school during lockdowns are now the ones entering and moving through university.

items.en: A Single Human Brain Cell May Be Far More Computationally Powerful Than Assumed
items.zh: 研究指單一人類腦細胞的運算能力遠超過去認知
items.summary: New work reported this week suggests that a single human neuron may be far more computationally powerful than researchers previously assumed, with individual cells performing operations that were long thought to require small networks. If the result holds, it complicates the standard analogy between artificial neurons and biological ones that underpins a lot of popular writing about AI. It also matters for learning science: the capacity limits people assume about attention and memory are partly inherited from an outdated model of what one cell can do.

items.en: Anthropic Locks In a 20-Year, 191 MW Compute Deal With Riot Platforms Worth $9.1 Billion
items.zh: Anthropic 與 Riot Platforms 簽 20 年、191MW、91 億美元算力長約，年限到 2048
items.summary: Anthropic signed a twenty-year, 191-megawatt compute agreement with Riot Platforms valued at $9.1 billion and running through June 2048. The counterparty is the story: Riot is a bitcoin miner, and the deal continues the pattern of AI labs buying already-energised grid capacity from crypto operators rather than waiting years for new interconnection. A twenty-year term also signals that Anthropic is treating power, not chips, as the binding constraint on its roadmap. Commentators framed 12 August as the point where the AI race became a capital and governance contest.

items.en: IonQ Posts 287% Revenue Growth to $80 Million and Closes Its $1.8 Billion SkyWater Acquisition
items.zh: IonQ 第二季營收年增 287% 至 8,010 萬美元，18 億美元併購 SkyWater 晶圓廠完成交割
items.summary: IonQ reported second-quarter 2026 revenue of $80.1 million, up 287% year over year, driven by deployments of its fifth-generation Tempo systems across computing, networking, sensing and security. It also closed a $1.8 billion acquisition of SkyWater Technology on 31 July, giving it onshore control of quantum processing unit design and fabrication. That vertical integration is the strategically important part: IonQ is shifting from laser-based to electronic qubit control for its planned 256-qubit and 10,000-qubit systems, which requires owning the semiconductor process.

items.en: SanDisk's Investor Day Long-Term Model Lifts the Entire Memory Complex
items.zh: SanDisk 投資人日釋出長期財務模型，帶動整個記憶體族群同步走強
items.summary: SanDisk used its 2026 investor day to publish a long-term financial model targeting mid-to-high-teens revenue growth for fiscal 2028 through 2030, non-GAAP gross margins near 80%, operating margins around 75% and adjusted free cash flow margin near 50%. Those are software-like margins for a hardware business, and the market repriced the whole storage complex in sympathy: SanDisk closed up 13.7%, Micron rose over 4%, and SK hynix gained about 8% in Seoul. Taiwan's memory names followed the same tape.

items.en: Kenshi Yonezu's 'GHOST' Arena Tour Ballot Results Landed on 12 August; 14 Shows Across Six Cities
items.zh: 米津玄師「2026 TOUR / GHOST」抽選結果 8/12 公布，全日本 6 都市 14 場、11/6 開跑
items.summary: Kenshi Yonezu's arena tour 'Kenshi Yonezu 2026 TOUR / GHOST' runs from 6 November to 17 December 2026 across six Japanese cities and fourteen dates, marking his return to the live stage. The general lottery closed on 26 July and results were released at noon on 12 August, so anyone who entered should check now. There are no Taiwan or Hong Kong dates announced. For overseas fans the realistic route is a Japan leg plus the resale rounds that typically open closer to each venue date.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE's Sixth Album Arrives 30 September, With a First Arena Tour in Three Years
items.zh: Mrs. GREEN APPLE 第六張專輯 9/30 發行，睽違三年巡迴 9/30 起跑
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE confirmed that its sixth studio album lands on 30 September, and that the band's first arena tour in three years begins the same month, running through December 2026 across multiple Japanese venues. The announcement follows a stadium run that drew roughly 390,000 fans and was accompanied by live viewing screenings in Taiwan and Hong Kong. Arena dates are a far more realistic ticketing target for overseas fans than the stadium shows were, and live viewing has precedent for this act.

items.en: YOASOBI's 'Never Ending Stories' North American Tour Closes at the Hollywood Bowl on 16 August
items.zh: YOASOBI 北美巡演 8/4–8/16，最終場好萊塢露天劇場，為生涯最大規模北美巡迴
items.summary: YOASOBI's 'Never Ending Stories' North American tour runs 4 to 16 August 2026, the duo's largest North American run to date, with eight dates including OSHEAGA and Lollapalooza and a stop at Climate Pledge Arena in Seattle on 12 August. The tour, powered by Crunchyroll, closes at the 20,000-capacity Hollywood Bowl in Los Angeles. There are no Taiwan, Hong Kong or Japan dates in this leg, so the tour ends this weekend; watch for a domestic Japan announcement after it wraps.
items.source: Anime News Network / Climate Pledge Arena

items.en: Ado and Fujii Kaze Continue the J-Pop Push Into North American Arenas
items.zh: Ado、藤井風持續進軍北美 arena 級場館，J-POP 海外規模再上一階
items.summary: Industry coverage of the YOASOBI run noted that since 2025 Ado, Atarashii Gakko!, Fujii Kaze, Number_i and Mrs. GREEN APPLE have all announced or played North American arena dates, a step change from the club and theatre circuit that J-pop acts occupied for years. No new Taiwan or Hong Kong dates were announced for Ado or Fujii Kaze in this 48-hour window. The pattern worth tracking is that Asian legs are usually announced after the North American run is sold through.

market.note:
昨天（8/13）是台美兩邊「同方向、同題材」的一天，而且是這個月最漂亮的一根。

【台股】加權指數大漲 503.41 點、收 46,021.48（+1.11%），一舉站上 46,000 大關。上漲的動能來自兩條線同時發動：① 美國 7 月 CPI 降溫，降息預期回溫，半導體開盤跳空走高；② 被動元件族群大爆發，國巨（2327）因挪威主權基金持股比率提升，股價突破月線直接衝上漲停，帶著華新科（2492，收 288 元）、禾伸堂同步走強，MLCC 成為當天最強主攻。第三條線是記憶體，MSCI 季調帶動記憶體轉強，券商當日「強勢動能排行」前三名是力積電（6770）、南亞科（2408）、信昌電。權值股方面，台積電收 2,435 元（+20 元、約 +0.83%）穩穩撐盤。市場廣度非常好，全場上漲家數逾 7,400 檔、漲停 131 檔——這不是少數權值拉抬的假上漲。

【美股】三大指數同步收高，S&P 500 收 7,798.99（+0.65%），寫下歷史收盤新高並首度站上 7,800；那斯達克收 26,803.03（+0.81%）；道瓊收 53,839.99（+69.72 點、+0.13%）。催化劑是 7 月 PPI（生產者物價）同樣降溫，加上油價回落——荷姆茲的緊張還在，但油價昨天走的是回檔。最猛的族群是記憶體與儲存：SanDisk（SNDK）投資人日公布 2028–2030 長期財務模型（營收成長中高個位數到十幾趴、non-GAAP 毛利率約 80%、營益率約 75%），市場直接把整個儲存族群重新定價，SNDK 收漲 13.7%、美光（MU）漲逾 4%、南韓 SK 海力士漲約 8%。另外 Workday（WDAY）因傳出 Silver Lake 洽談收購，盤中一度暫停交易，收盤大漲 17.8%，一根就把今年以來的 -18% 翻正。
market.highlight:
⚠️ 今天（8/14 週五）開盤前三件事：

① 台股的記憶體＋被動元件雙引擎會不會續攻，是今天唯一的重點。昨天 131 檔漲停、上漲逾 7,400 檔，這種廣度通常不會只有一天，但也很少連續三天。要盯的是量能：昨天是「跳空開高走低」的走勢（開盤最強、尾盤稍軟），如果今天開高又走低、量卻放大，那是短線籌碼在換手出貨，不是續攻。

② 美股記憶體行情是「SanDisk 投資人日」帶起來的，本質是估值重評，不是需求數字。SNDK +13.7%、MU +4.2%、SK 海力士 +8% 這種同步大漲，台股的南亞科、華邦電、旺宏、力積電今天開盤幾乎一定跟著跳高——但請記得 8/10→8/11 那次教訓：記憶體漲停隔天回吐超過 2.5%。追高前先看有沒有外資實質買超，不要只看跳空缺口。

③ 荷姆茲風險還在但方向反了。昨天 ADNOC 兩艘船遭攻擊、IEA 警告全球在燒庫存，油價卻是下跌的——市場已經把「海峽長期不通」定價進去，短線在賭談判。這代表任何一則「談判重啟」或「船運恢復」的消息，油價與能源股的波動都會被放大。與你觀察清單直接相關的是：油價回落＋通膨降溫＝降息預期回溫＝科技股與高成長股（PLTR、量子族群、加密相關）受惠最大，這也是昨天那斯達克贏過道瓊 0.68 個百分點的原因。
